1.yusuf_ali: By the (Steeds) that run, with panting (breath),
1.shakir: I swear by the runners breathing pantingly,
1.muhammad_sarwar: (I swear) by the snorting chargers (of the warriors), whose hoofs strike against the rocks
1.mohsin_khan: By the (steeds) that run, with panting (breath),

2.sahih_international: And the producers of sparks [when] striking
2.shakir: Then those that produce fire striking,
2.mohsin_khan: Striking sparks of fire (by their hooves),

3.pickthall: And scouring to the raid at dawn,
3.yusuf_ali: And push home the charge in the morning,
3.shakir: Then those that make raids at morn,
3.muhammad_sarwar: while running during a raid at dawn,
3.mohsin_khan: And scouring to the raid at dawn

4.pickthall: Then, therewith, with their trail of dust,
4.yusuf_ali: And raise the dust in clouds the while,
4.muhammad_sarwar: and leave behind a cloud of dust
4.mohsin_khan: And raise the dust in clouds the while,

5.sahih_international: Arriving thereby in the center collectively,
5.pickthall: Cleaving, as one, the centre (of the foe),
5.yusuf_ali: And penetrate forthwith into the midst (of the foe) en masse;-
5.shakir: Then rush thereby upon an assembly:
5.mohsin_khan: Penetrating forthwith as one into the midst (of the foe);

6.sahih_international: Indeed mankind, to his Lord, is ungrateful.
6.pickthall: Lo! man is an ingrate unto his Lord
6.yusuf_ali: Truly man is, to his Lord, ungrateful;
6.shakir: Most surely man is ungrateful to his Lord.
6.muhammad_sarwar: The human being is certainly ungrateful to his Lord.
6.mohsin_khan: Verily! Man (disbeliever) is ungrateful to his Lord;
6.arberry: Surely Man is ungrateful to his Lord,

7.sahih_international: And indeed, he is to that a witness.
7.pickthall: And lo! he is a witness unto that;
7.yusuf_ali: And to that (fact) he bears witness (by his deeds);
7.shakir: And most surely he is a witness of that.
7.muhammad_sarwar: He himself knows this very well.
7.mohsin_khan: And to that fact he bears witness (by his deeds);
7.arberry: and surely he is a witness against that!

8.sahih_international: And indeed he is, in love of wealth, intense.
8.pickthall: And lo! in the love of wealth he is violent.
8.yusuf_ali: And violent is he in his love of wealth.
8.shakir: And most surely he is tenacious in the love of wealth.
8.muhammad_sarwar: He certainly has a strong love for wealth and riches.
8.mohsin_khan: And verily, he is violent in the love of wealth.
8.arberry: Surely he is passionate in his love for good things.

9.sahih_international: But does he not know that when the contents of the graves are scattered
9.pickthall: Knoweth he not that, when the contents of the graves are poured forth
9.yusuf_ali: Does he not know,- when that which is in the graves is scattered abroad
9.shakir: Does he not then know when what is in the graves is raised,
9.muhammad_sarwar: Does he not know that on the day when those in the graves are resurrected
9.mohsin_khan: Knows he not that when the contents of the graves are brought out and poured forth (all mankind is resurrected).
9.arberry: Knows he not that when that which is in the tombs is over-thrown,

10.sahih_international: And that within the breasts is obtained,
10.pickthall: And the secrets of the breasts are made known,
10.yusuf_ali: And that which is (locked up) in (human) breasts is made manifest-
10.shakir: And what is in the breasts is made apparent?
10.muhammad_sarwar: and all that is in the hearts is made public,
10.mohsin_khan: And that which is in the breasts (of men) shall be made known.
10.arberry: and that which is in the breasts is brought out --

11.sahih_international: Indeed, their Lord with them, that Day, is [fully] Acquainted.
11.pickthall: On that day will their Lord be perfectly informed concerning them.
11.yusuf_ali: That their Lord had been Well-acquainted with them, (even to) that Day?
11.shakir: Most surely their Lord that day shall be fully aware of them.
11.muhammad_sarwar: their Lord will examine his deeds?
11.mohsin_khan: Verily, that Day (i.e. the Day of Resurrection) their Lord will be Well-Acquainted with them (as to their deeds), (and will reward them for their deeds).
11.arberry: surely on that day their Lord shall be aware of them!
